column1: # This repository's history has been rewritten three times:
#   1. 2026-08-18  purge an OpenRouter API key committed during Phase 3.
#      GitHub push protection correctly refused the push until it was gone.
#   2. 2026-08-18  remove .claude/ from every commit and consolidate commit
#   3. 2026-08-21  remove Idea/ from every commit. Those are the author's own
#      working notes and belong on the local machine, not in a public
#      repository. They remain on disk and are gitignored.
# Removing content from a commit changes its hash and every descendant's, so
# most commit ids moved. Every experiment under `experiments/` records the
# commit that produced it in its own `git_commit.txt`, and those files still
# hold the ORIGINAL hashes -- rewriting a recorded result so it agrees with a
# later convenience is exactly what this project's provenance rules exist to
# prevent, and a ledger that gets quietly corrected is not append-only.
# This file is the bridge, cumulative across all three rewrites. It maps a hash
# as recorded to the commit carrying that work in the current history.
# Columns: old_sha<TAB>new_sha. Identical values mean the commit was untouched.
